items.title: Build your own benchmark before trusting an AI scribe
items.body: This is the most practically useful edition for the surgery. Run two or three scribes blind on a handful of your own real consultation types, including a difficult one, score side by side, then decide to switch, split or stay. Anonymise anything used.

items.title: Pick tasks you would stake decisions on
items.body: The test should include the awkward cases: strong accents, interpreters, multiple speakers, mental health consultations. A scribe that is excellent on a simple cough may fail there.

items.title: Mind the cost of testing
items.body: Seven models was too many even for an expert. One incumbent against one challenger is a realistic test for a practice, and any trial involving real patient data needs proper information governance.
